name: automation-platform
description: Centralized launcher for the Automation Platform (frontend + all backend services).

scripts.backend:sprintguard: cross-env API_HOST=127.0.0.1 API_PORT=8000 python -m uvicorn backend.sprintguard.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.backend:api-testing: cross-env PYTHONPATH=backend/api-testing APIT_PORT=8002 python -m uvicorn apitest.main:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002 --reload
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt -r backend/api-testing/requirements.txt -r backend/load-testing/requirements.txt -r backend/ui-automation/requirements.txt
